# About Me

Hello, I'm Nandita Shankar. Welcome to my website! I am a senior undergraduate at CWRU pursuing a BS in Biology with minors in Anthropology, Chemistry, and Spanish. I am concurrently pursuing an MS in Clinical Research. I love to spend my free time listening to music (my favorite artist at the moment is The Strokes) and reading (my favorite author at the moment is Charlie Donlea)!

On this website, you will find some information regarding my education and experience as well as my curriculum vitae. Please feel free to [contact me](mailto:nandita.shankar2@case.edu).
